notes.title: Breakout Beyond Patch Notes For June 18, 2025
notes.notes:
In addition to minor bug fixes as well as adding an option to change which input axis is read for mouse/joystick, today’s update introduces the ability to select your display orientation for some vertical brick breaking!



To change your display orientation, navigate to OPTIONS, go to Layout, then change Screen to Vertical. Rotate your display and enjoy!



You may see people calling this TATE mode! TATE (pronounced tah-tay) is a Japanese term referring to arcade games with vertically oriented screens, usually seen in vertical scrolling shoot-em-ups. 



Thank you for continuing to enjoy Breakout Beyond!

notes.title: Hotfix - Patch Notes for 4/11/2025
notes.notes:
This patch addresses the following:


 Fixed bug where "Blast from the Past" achievement wouldn't unlock under certain conditions
 Fixes Infinite mode not being infinite
 Added D-Pad controls
 Added new leaderboard for Voyage mode
 Added Quality of Life improvements to level select screen
 Additional bug fixes
